groups.root_cause: Setup does not reload or restart an already-healthy daemon after writing new configuration, so the daemon keeps running on its old settings.
Smoke checks run against a hardcoded set of built-in providers instead of the providers actually configured and available.
Setup saves newly selected repositories without first checking that they can be accessed.
Interactive initialization never asks for or saves the discreet-mode preference.
Doctor only probes providers that have an explicit health URL, so it never checks credentials for the others.
Init's already-configured check matches on the preset an entry uses, not its provider name, so an alias like work-claude counts as the native claude entry.
